title: Replace Your Driver's License or Learner's Permit
content: If your Virginia driver's license is lost, stolen, or damaged, you can get a replacement. You may replace it online unless certain conditions apply (such as being under 18, having an expired credential, needing a name change, or owing DMV fees); the online process reuses your existing photograph. In person at a DMV customer service center you need a completed Driver's License and Identification Card Application, one proof of identity document (additional documents for REAL ID), a new photograph taken on site, and payment of fees. A replacement license costs $20 (an additional $10 one-time fee for REAL ID).
required_information: Driver's License and Identification Card Application (in person)
One proof of identity document (in person; more for REAL ID)
next_action: Check whether you can replace your Virginia driver's license online; if not, visit a DMV customer service center.
